deferred.claim: Cast United Battlefront to look at the top seven cards, put up to two qualifying permanent cards onto the battlefield, and put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
deferred.basis: Look at the top seven cards of your library. Put up to two noncreature, nonland permanent cards with mana value 3 or less from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
